meta.title: Level 10: The Master Architect
meta.description: Two separate clusters are barely holding together. Analyze the structural integrity.
meta.errorMessage: Incorrect analysis. Look closely at the connections between the clusters.

solutionPhases.instruction: Identify the 'Articulation Point' (The ID of the single node that, if removed, splits the graph in two).
Click the 'Bridge' edge that connects the two distinct clusters.
If you had to turn this entire network into a Minimum Spanning Tree, what would be its total weight?
